subject: System Design
title: The Strangler Fig Pattern
description: Learn The Strangler Fig Pattern in one minute.

hook.text: A strangler fig wraps around a tree, slowly replacing it. You can migrate from monolith to microservices the same way.

buildup.text: Route new features to new services. Gradually move old features out of the monolith, one at a time.

discovery.text: The monolith and new services run side by side. A routing layer directs traffic to the right destination.

twist.text: Some monolith features are too entangled to extract cleanly. You might need to rewrite them rather than migrate.

climax.text: The strangler fig pattern avoids the risk of a big-bang rewrite by migrating incrementally over months or years.

punchline.text: Wrap the monolith gradually — replace it piece by piece.

quiz.question: What is the strangler fig pattern?
options: Gradually replacing a monolith by routing features to new services one at a time
Running two monoliths side by side
